name: agent-handoff
description: Keep long AI coding sessions aligned with a concise project HANDOFF.md.

interface.shortDescription: Maintain HANDOFF.md for long Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Agent Handoff helps Codex preserve the original goal, current focus, key decisions, failed attempts, changed files, and next steps in a concise HANDOFF.md that future sessions or other AI coding agents can read.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Handoff for this project.

Update HANDOFF.md before ending meaningful work.
